text: Health education example: hand hygiene with soap and clean water is a simple way to reduce the spread of many infections. This general information does not replace advice from a qualified healthcare professional.

Health education example: adequate sleep, balanced nutrition, physical activity, and avoiding tobacco can support general wellbeing. Individual needs vary, so discuss personal concerns with a qualified clinician.
Health education example: antibiotics treat certain bacterial infections and do not treat viral illnesses. Only use antibiotics when prescribed by an appropriately qualified healthcare professional.

Health education example: chest pain, severe difficulty breathing, signs of stroke, or loss of consciousness may be emergencies. Contact local emergency services immediately rather than relying on an AI system.
Health education example: a screening test is not always a diagnosis. A qualified clinician interprets results using symptoms, examination, medical history, and appropriate follow-up testing.

Health education example: medication safety depends on the person, medicine, dose, allergies, other medicines, and health conditions. Ask a pharmacist or clinician before changing or starting medication.
